title: Actual sections restriction commutes with normalized strict derived limits
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be sites small in a common universe, with terminal objects [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-size-convention]. Let $h:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ be a geometric morphism, let $B$ be a commutative ring sheaf on $\mathcal C$, and put $B'=h^{-1}B$, with the identity structural map [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. Use module sheaves and their ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Assume that countable products of $B$-modules and of $B'$-modules are exact and the exact module inverse image $h^*$ preserves countable products.
Write $L_B,L_{B'},L_{\mathbf Z}$ for total right derived inverse limit on strict inverse sequences of module sheaves or abelian groups [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. Put $H_B=R\Gamma_{\mathcal C,B}:D(B)\to D(\mathbf{Ab})$ and $H_{B'}=R\Gamma_{\mathcal D,B'}$, with actual module-derived sections: the right derived functor [def-sfb-right-derived-functor] of the functor sending a module sheaf to the abelian group of sections of its underlying abelian sheaf at the terminal object. For every $K\in D(B)$ let
$$\rho_K:H_BK\longrightarrow H_{B'}h^*K$$
be the actual restriction: the derived adjunction unit $K\to Rh_*h^*K$ followed by the canonical sections/direct-image composition isomorphism. On strict towers use the analogous actual derived tower adjunction to define
$$\rho^{\operatorname{Tow}}:H_B^{\operatorname{Tow}}\longrightarrow H_{B'}^{\operatorname{Tow}}h^{*,\operatorname{Tow}},$$
where $H^{\operatorname{Tow}}$ is the total right derived functor of termwise sections; evaluation gives $\rho_{K_n}$, including every tower transition.
Use the normalized inverse-image comparison $\lambda_K:h^*L_BK\cong L_{B'}h^{*,\operatorname{Tow}}K$ of [lem-cbc-exact-product-functor-strict-limit], and the canonical direct-image comparisons
$$a_{B,K}:H_BL_BK\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{\mathbf Z}H_B^{\operatorname{Tow}}K,\qquad
a_{B',h^*K}:H_{B'}L_{B'}h^{*,\operatorname{Tow}}K\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{\mathbf Z}H_{B'}^{\operatorname{Tow}}h^{*,\operatorname{Tow}}K$$
of [lem-weil-ringed-tower-pushforward-limit-comparison], applied to the global-sections ringed morphisms. Then for every strict tower complex $K$,
$$a_{B',h^*K}\circ H_{B'}(\lambda_K)\circ\rho_{L_BK}
=L_{\mathbf Z}(\rho^{\operatorname{Tow}}_K)\circ a_{B,K}.$$
This equality is natural in $D(\operatorname{Tow}(B))$ and respects all strict augmentations, using the normalized Roos augmentation with zero shifted-product coordinate. No boundedness is imposed, and no assertion that any individual $\rho_K$ is an isomorphism is made.

proof.text: Construct the ordinary sections comparison from maps out of the terminal singleton sheaf. The inverse-image functor preserves the terminal singleton. The set adjunction gives a natural bijection on sections; ring_one and module_linear prove additivity. Its defining adjunction equation is IsSectionsComparison.

source.place: Tags 01FT and 0D6E: sections as maps from the terminal sheaf and the geometric adjunction.

proof.text: Package the existing cochain right-derived units as natural transformations. The K-injective derivability criterion gives their universal property. Descend the ordinary restriction transformation H(unit) followed by the direct-image/sections comparison. Its factorization holds on every complex, hence implies the stated K-injective normalization.

source.place: Tag 0D6E, derived pushforward composition; derived.tex Tag 070I, K-injective representatives and universal right derived functors.

proof.text: Package the specified exact derived evaluations and transitions as a tower-valued functor. Apply the existing universal derived evaluation comparison to that functor. Naturality inside the tower proves every transition equation; evaluation of the restriction unit equation and the exact-localization interchange equation give compatibility with restriction.

source.place: Tags 0940/0941, strict towers; exact derived evaluation normalization and the unit computation at each level.

proof.text: For an additive functor between the Grothendieck categories in use, resolve a K-injective source tower by a K-injective tower with injective terms. Its transitions split. Their images split, and the Roos kernel short exact sequence shows that the target inverse-limit unit is invertible on the image tower. Homotopy equivalence transports this property back. This is the proof of the coefficient-sequence sections acyclicity helper, generalized locally to the independent derived-category universe and to the exact-product target category.

source.place: Tag 0A07, derived inverse limit of direct images; Tag 0941, split inverse sequences and the Roos complex.

proof.text: Apply the universal comparison for two derived composites to ordinary sections/limit and inverse-image/limit. Sections preserves limits by forgetting to underlying sets. Exact inverse image preserves countable inverse limits by the countable-product/equalizer construction. The common-underived-composite unit equations produce aR, aS and lambda, and give the stronger normalization on all complexes.

source.place: Tag 0A07, derived pushforward commutes with derived inverse limit; universal derived composite comparisons.

proof.text: Check the ordinary restriction/limit equation degreewise and projectionwise, using naturality of the adjunction unit and the ordinary sections comparison. On a K-injective tower cancel the units for limit and sections, substitute the preceding normalized equations, and use naturality of the abelian derived-limit unit at the restriction chain map. Equality of natural transformations on K-injective representatives gives the main square everywhere.

source.place: Tag 0A07, the naturality calculation for the universal derived inverse-limit unit; derived.tex Tag 070I.

proof.text: Use strictRoosDerivation and uniqueness of the right derived functor to obtain theta and thetaS for the prescribed inverse-limit functors. Transport between the limit of complexes and the complex of degreewise limits. The universal unit factorization proves Q(limitInclusion) followed by theta equals the prescribed unit on every complex. The existing ordinary-limit-of-complexes isomorphism from the Roos resolution normalization supplies this transport.

source.place: Tags 0940/0941, Roos realization of derived inverse limit and its normalized unit.

proof.text: Factor an arbitrary strict Roos augmentation through the ordinary inverse limit. Its projections determine the inverse-image factorization. The all-complex lambda normalization and the Roos unit factorization identify its two derived augmentation maps. Naturality of rho and the main square give the final augmentation equation with the same fixed choices.

source.place: Tag 0941, strict Roos augmentation and naturality of derived inverse limit.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0940, 0941, 0A07 and 0D6E. E2 uses universal derived-unit factorizations on all complexes, the existing composite/evaluation APIs and a local universe-general form of the proved split-transition acyclicity argument.
